abstract: Monitors dedicated evacuation corridors, convoy transfer windows, and material handling mechanisms
system_message:
You are the Emergency Logistics Coordinator (LOG), responsible for monitoring dedicated evacuation corridors, convoy transfer windows, material handling mechanisms, and emergency backup fueling across candidate deep-storage vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors dedicated evacuation corridors, convoy transfer windows, and material handling mechanisms（TRANS）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRANS-5N8：For Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault, the emergency route validation exercise measured a maximum emergency convoy transit duration of 135 min under congested contingency traffic conditions from the National Antiquities Museum, and vertical transport commissioning inspection confirmed the heavy freight elevator is operational with certified ten-tonne capacity.
LOG-TRANS-0SZ：For Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex, contingency testing recorded an emergency convoy transit duration of 220 min under congested contingency traffic conditions along the museum corridor, and the heavy freight elevator is operational per vertical transport commissioning inspection.
LOG-TRANS-FO1：For Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository, the route validation exercise logged an emergency convoy transit duration of 180 min under congested contingency traffic conditions, and the vertical transport inspection verified that the heavy freight elevator is operational.

information_points.title: Emergency backup fueling（FUEL）
information_points.content:
LOG-FUEL-UN0：For Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository, the auxiliary power audit determined an autonomous generator runtime of 336 h supported by on-site underground diesel reserves under full critical facility load.
LOG-FUEL-LO8：For Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault, the auxiliary power supply audit confirmed an autonomous generator runtime of 504 h based on on-site underground diesel reserve tanks operating under 100 percent critical facility load without refueling.
LOG-FUEL-5GA：For Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex, auxiliary power supply testing verified an autonomous generator runtime of 168 h under 100 percent critical facility load using on-site underground diesel reserves.
